tuples.title: AUD-ANTIRUG-001: the anti-rug reconnect and the DEX reconnect loops each rewrite ctx.wsProvider > reconnect-leaves-subscription-off-ctx-provider: after one socket drop the rug-log subscription exists once but on the anti-rug loop socket, while ctx.wsProvider ends on a DEX loop provider

AUD-ANTIRUG-001: the anti-rug reconnect and the DEX reconnect loops each rewrite ctx.wsProvider > replaced-providers-left-alive: after one socket drop, the providers ctx.wsProvider no longer points at are not destroyed and their sockets stay open

AUD-ANTIRUG-001: the anti-rug reconnect and the DEX reconnect loops each rewrite ctx.wsProvider > second-registration-duplicates-dispatch: after one drop, the next buy on the chain adds a second rug-log subscription for the earlier position, so one LP transfer on its pair is evaluated twice
AUD-ANTIRUG-002: a refused WebSocket connect ends the whole process > boot-refused-connect-exits: the boot WebSocket connect (getWsProvider) meets a refused port and the process exits
AUD-ANTIRUG-002: a refused WebSocket connect ends the whole process > detector-refused-reconnect-exits: the anti-rug reconnect after a socket drop meets a refused port and the process exits
AUD-ANTIRUG-002: a refused WebSocket connect ends the whole process > dex-v2-refused-reconnect-exits: the V2 DEX listener reconnect after a socket drop meets a refused port and the process exits
AUD-ANTIRUG-002: a refused WebSocket connect ends the whole process > dex-v3-refused-reconnect-exits: the V3 DEX listener reconnect after a socket drop meets a refused port and the process exits

AUD-ANTIRUG-003: the anti-rug circuit breaker counts each dispatch of one rug > breaker-counts-dispatches-not-rugs: one 95 percent liquidity pull, with the first anti-rug exit held in flight, counts three triggers and trips the chain breaker

AUD-ANTIRUG-004: a failed anti-rug escape is not retried > failed-escape-not-retried: an anti-rug exit whose approval the node refuses is never dispatched again within 2 minutes of fake time while the position is still held

AUD-ANTIRUG-005: the anti-rug backfill does not keep its own contract > backfill-fires-live-exit: a rug mined while the socket was down is replayed by the reconnect backfill, which reaches triggerAntiRugExit and submits an anti-rug sell

AUD-ANTIRUG-005: the anti-rug backfill does not keep its own contract > live-dispatch-does-not-advance-cursor: a rug log dispatched live leaves chain_state.last_seen_block at the arming backfill block, behind the log the bot already acted on

AUD-ANTIRUG-018: the HTTP anti-rug poller asks for its whole outstanding range and never recovers from a gap wider than the provider limit > restart-gap-blinds-http-poller: after an ordinary restart on a chain without a WebSocket URL, every anti-rug poll is refused by the provider range limit and a 95 percent liquidity pull is never evaluated

AUD-ANTIRUG-024: the first anti-rug start on a fresh database raises a false GAP DETECTED > first-start-false-gap-alert: boot step 4 on a fresh database alerts that the whole chain history was missed instead of seeding the cursor

AUD-ANTIRUG-025: a restart drops the anti-rug WebSocket subscription of every resumed position > resume-drops-ws-subscription: after restart and resume, the node holds no subscription for the pair and the restarted bot never sees an LP transfer on it

AUD-API-001: dashboard force-sell and emergency-sell skip a still-held position whose exit failed (ESC-PRE-04) > emergency-sell-skips-failed-held: after the catch path marks the position failed while its tokens are still held, emergency-sell answers "No open positions to sell" and sends no sell

AUD-API-001: dashboard force-sell and emergency-sell skip a still-held position whose exit failed (ESC-PRE-04) > force-sell-skips-failed-held: after the catch path marks the position failed while its tokens are still held, force-sell answers 404 and sends no sell

AUD-API-002: dashboard Stop removes the anti-rug subscription and Start does not bring it back > start-does-not-rearm-antirug: after the real Stop and Start routes (Start running the real onRestart of an in-process boot), the node still holds no anti-rug subscription for the pair and a liquidity pull is never evaluated

AUD-API-002: dashboard Stop removes the anti-rug subscription and Start does not bring it back > stop-disarms-antirug: after the real Stop route, the node holds no anti-rug subscription for the pair, a 95 percent liquidity pull is never evaluated, and the dashboard is still told the chain is connected
AUD-API-008: one malformed Host header on an upgrade request ends the whole process > malformed-host-upgrade-exits: GET /ws with Upgrade: websocket and Host "a b" ends the process

AUD-BUY-001: a landed deliberate buy is armed only in the short-lived script process > monitor-dies-with-script and anti-rug-dies-with-script: the real scripts/deliberate-buy.ts lands a buy and arms both protections in its own process, exits 0, and the running bot on the same database picks up neither

AUD-BUY-001: a landed deliberate buy is armed only in the short-lived script process > monitor-dies-with-script and anti-rug-dies-with-script: the real scripts/deliberate-buy.ts lands a buy and arms both protections in its own process, exits 0, and the running bot on the same database picks up neither

AUD-BUY-002: a landed buy recorded as failed or not at all (RC-01) > balanceof-error-flips-landed-buy-to-failed: one balanceOf error after the buy mined flips the row to failed, starts no exit monitor, alerts "TX failed", and a restart does not resume the held position

AUD-BUY-002: a landed buy recorded as failed or not at all (RC-01) > balanceof-error-flips-landed-buy-to-failed: one balanceOf error after the buy mined flips the row to failed, starts no exit monitor, alerts "TX failed", and a restart does not resume the held position

AUD-BUY-002: a landed buy recorded as failed or not at all (RC-01) > earlier-attempt-lands-no-trade-row: attempt 0 is not included at its first target block, attempt 1 signs the same nonce, attempt 0 then lands and the bot records no trade

AUD-BUY-002: a landed buy recorded as failed or not at all (RC-01) > fanout-error-after-send-no-trade-row: the relay refuses a later block of the fanout after the bundle for the first block was sent; the bot records nothing and that bundle lands

AUD-BUY-003: the snipe buy minOut fails open when the quote fails (RC-02) > v2-quote-failure-sends-zero-amount-out-min: a failed getAmountsOut leaves minOut 0 and the V2 swap is still sent with amountOutMin 0

AUD-BUY-003: the snipe buy minOut fails open when the quote fails (RC-02) > v3-quote-failure-sends-zero-amount-out-minimum: a failed quoteExactInputSingle leaves minOut 0 and the V3 multicall still carries amountOutMinimum 0

AUD-BUY-004: the already-sniped check is read once, long before the row is written, so two handlers for one token both buy > double-buy-same-token: a second handler for the same PairCreated passes the check while the first buy is inside the lock, and both buys land

AUD-BUY-005: a rejection from the un-awaited V3 pool handler ends the whole process > v3-listener-unhandled-rejection-exits: a bad ETH_MIN_LIQUIDITY rejects the un-awaited V3 handler on the first pool and the process exits

AUD-BUY-006: the Telegram allowlist accepts every source unless both lists are set > empty-lists-accept-any-source: with neither list set, a message from an unknown sender in an unknown chat routes into the buy pipeline and a buy is sent

AUD-BUY-006: the Telegram allowlist accepts every source unless both lists are set > sender-only-list-accepts-any-sender: with only the sender list set, a message from a sender not on it is still accepted (the empty channel list allows every chat) and a buy is sent

AUD-BUY-007: the dead simulateSell signs a real approve of the whole balance, outside the nonce lock > simulate-sell-signs-approve-outside-nonce-lock: calling simulateSell on a held token signs one approve while the wallet lock is held

AUD-BUY-008: a dashboard restart adds a second reconnect loop per DEX on the same socket > restart-stacks-reconnect-loop: after a dashboard Stop and Start on a connected socket, one socket close runs two reconnect loops for the DEX

AUD-BUY-009: the New-Token alert prints a constant honeypot field > v2-alert-honeypot-field-is-constant: an ordinary V2 launch passes the on-chain roundtrip, and the alert prints a bare "No" from a constant

AUD-BUY-009: the New-Token alert prints a constant honeypot field > v3-alert-honeypot-field-is-constant: an ordinary V3 launch passes the on-chain roundtrip, and the alert prints a bare "No" from a constant

AUD-BUY-010: risk limits are checked long before the snipe is recorded, so concurrent handlers for different tokens all pass > max-open-positions-overspent: with room for exactly one more position, handlers for two different tokens both pass canSnipe and both buys land

AUD-BUY-011: dashboard Stop does not stop buying on the chain > http-poller-buys-after-stop: on a chain without a WebSocket URL, after the real stop route the HTTP poller still finds a new pair and the bot buys

AUD-BUY-011: dashboard Stop does not stop buying on the chain > telegram-routes-to-stopped-chain: on a WebSocket chain, the real stop route removes the factory listener, yet a Telegram alpha drop from an allowlisted sender still routes to the stopped chain and the bot buys

AUD-BUY-015: the V3 minimum-liquidity gate only proves the quoter did not revert > thin-pool-passes-min-liquidity-gate: a pool with 0.001 ETH of depth against a 0.5 ETH threshold passes the gate and the bot buys

AUD-TX-002, AUD-BUY-025, AUD-EXIT-009: a wait() with no timeout inside the real withNonceLock (RC-10 never-settling wait) > deliberate-public-wait-holds-wallet-lock: a deliberate buy whose public transaction is never mined keeps the wallet lock, and a later operation for the wallet does not start within a 30-minute fake-time window (150 blocks)

AUD-BUY-027: factory events are not filtered to wrapped-native pairs > non-native-pair-checked-and-bought: a PairCreated for an A/B pair is processed as a snipe, its B reserve is read as native, and the bot buys A through WETH

AUD-BUY-028: the lock gate passes on any active lock, whatever share of the LP it covers > mudra-one-percent-lock-passes: on BSC, a Mudra lock of 1 percent of the LP supply passes the lock gate and the bot buys

AUD-BUY-028: the lock gate passes on any active lock, whatever share of the LP it covers > unicrypt-one-percent-lock-passes: on ETH, a Unicrypt lock of 1 percent of the LP supply passes the lock gate and the bot buys

AUD-BUY-030: the deliberate public buy is not pinned to the private attempt nonce > public-buy-not-pinned-to-private-nonce: the last private attempt lands after the guard read the nonce, and the public buy takes the next nonce and lands as a second buy

AUD-BUY-033: a V3 snipe sends the whole amount as ETH value and never refunds it > v3-multicall-has-no-refund: the V3 snipe batch is multicall(deadline, [exactInputSingle]) with value the whole snipe amount and no refundETH

AUD-BUY-036: the HTTP DEX poller never recovers from an outage longer than the provider log-range limit > outage-blinds-http-dex-poller: after a 12-block RPC outage while the bot runs, every factory poll is refused and a new pair is never found

AUD-DB-003: a still-held position whose exit failed drops out of the risk limits > failed-held-not-counted-open: with one still-held failed-exit position and MAX_OPEN_POSITIONS 1, canSnipe allows the next snipe

AUD-DB-005: LOG_LEVEL in .env is never applied, because the logger is created before .env is loaded > log-level-from-env-file-not-applied: with VITEST unset and LOG_LEVEL=debug in .env, the logger runs at info
AUD-DB-006 (open half): every import of src/utils/db.ts writes to the database > import-writes-database: importing src/utils/db on an up-to-date WAL database commits a write (one WAL frame)

AUD-EXIT-007: exits with nowhere to go leave a held position with no poll timer > v3-private-not-landed-leaves-no-poll: a dashboard force-sell of a V3 position whose private sell does not land returns false and the position is never polled again

AUD-EXIT-008: dashboard sells are refused once routine retries are paused > operator-sell-refused-while-routine-paused: after the routine retries of a still-held position pause, the dashboard force-sell answers 409 and sends no sell

AUD-TX-001: withNonceLock has no owner tracking, so a nested same-wallet acquire never settles (RC-10 re-entrancy) > nested-acquire-never-settles: a same-wallet acquire inside a withNonceLock op leaves the outer call unsettled and a later op for the wallet unstarted within a 30-minute fake-time window

AUD-TX-009: an RPC hiccup during the Flashbots bundle wait ends the whole process > bundle-wait-null-block-exits: the target block answering null once during bundle.wait() ends the process

AUD-TX-028: one stalled HTTP call stalls every later call of the provider > stalled-call-stalls-antirug-evaluation: while one exit quote is held, the anti-rug evaluation of a liquidity pull gets its reads answered but cannot finish
